resources.string: Isilawuli esidadayo se-Private Audio. Isimo: %1$s. Izilawuli zokuvula okanye ukucima, zokwandisa nezokuvala.

I-Private Audio ayiqokeleli, ayirekhodi, okanye ayithumeli iincoko zakho okanye umxholo weaudio.

Le app ayifuni akhawunti okanye ungene ngemvume. Ayiceli imvume yokusebenzisa imayikrofoni kwaye ayisebenzisi uhlalutyo losetyenziso, iintengiso, okanye iinkonzo zokunika ingxelo xa iapp ima ngokungalindelekanga. I-Private Audio ayiceli imvume ye-Intanethi ye-Android kwaye ayithumeli datha kwiseva.

I-Private Audio iqwalasela kuphela isimo sobugcisa kunye nemethadatha yesistim yeaudio ye-Android njengoko kuyimfuneko ekuhambiseni iaudio nakuxilongo. Ayifikeleli kumxholo weencoko zakho.

Iisetingi zeapp zigcinwa kwisixhobo sakho kuphela. Idatha yoxilongo yenziwa ize iqwalaselwe kwisixhobo sakho, kwaye ingxelo yoxilongo igcinwa kuphela xa ukhetha ukuyigcina. Ingxelo isenokuquka iinkcukacha zobugcisa ngesixhobo sakho, uhlobo lwe-Android, ukuhanjiswa kweaudio, kunye nesimo sesistim yeaudio, kodwa ayiqulathanga ncoko okanye umxholo weaudio.

Ugcino lwedatha yeapp ye-Android luvaliwe.
I-Private Audio ngoku ilandela ulwimi lwesixhobo sakho. Kukhethwe Okumiselweyo.
Ukukhetha ulwimi ngaphakathi kwiapp kufuna i-Android 13 okanye entsha. Esi sixhobo silandela ulwimi lwesistim.
Cima isikrini xa ifowuni ikufutshane nendlebe yakho
Iinketho ezongezelelekileyo ziza kuvela apha njengoko i-Private Audio iphucuka.
I-Private Audio inceda ukuhambisa iaudio yelizwi exhaswayo kwisamkeli sendlebe esakhelwe ngaphakathi kwifowuni yakho.
Iseshoni yeaudio iphele ngaphambi kokuba ukuhanjiswa kwayo kugqitywe.
I-Private Audio ayikwazanga ukuqalisa ukuhambisa iaudio.
I-Private Audio ayikwazanga ukulungiselela iaudio yonxibelelwano.
Isicelo sokuhambisa iaudio kwisamkeli sendlebe asamkelwanga.
